examples.query: Which categories of people are excluded from PM-KISAN benefits?

examples.query: Can farmers with more than two hectares receive PM-KISAN benefits?
retrieved_contexts: The scheme is for small and marginal farmer families. There is no landholding size limit for eligibility. The two-hectare limit was removed in 2019.

Initially PM-KISAN was limited to small and marginal farmers with up to 2 hectares of land. This restriction was removed with effect from 1st June 2019, making all farmer families eligible regardless of landholding size, subject to other exclusion criteria.

examples.query: What is the Maharashtra PDMC micro-irrigation scheme subsidy amount?
retrieved_contexts: The Maharashtra PDMC (Per Drop More Crop) micro-irrigation scheme provides subsidies for drip and sprinkler irrigation systems. The subsidy pattern varies by farmer category and system type.
For small and marginal farmers, the subsidy is 55% of the indicative cost. For other farmers, the subsidy is 45% of the indicative cost. The maximum permissible area is 5 hectares per beneficiary.
